historicalFailures.finding: Six candidate-core rapid-switch failures with original assertions; repaired and rerun as the six Audio cases above.
Before implementation, 28 of 31 unit cases passed; three new intent/pause cases failed.
Early event-based design stopped at the old pending-resume test; terminated explicitly. The mock previously changed a read-only playing snapshot without issuing a pause command.
Command-entry design initially emitted a late play event after explicit pause; pause revision guards repaired this failing test.

limitations: This task reran 81 targeted cases per shipped core format, not the complete historical CORE-22 matrix.
Audio recheck uses a source-built core and explicit Audio main bytes; core main/legacy are separately verified against installed tarball bytes.
AUDIO-RESUME-01 on published core plus candidate audio, native boundary precision and real network starvation remain Audio-05 work.
Physical-device evidence, performance/size risks and final release reviews remain open; no publication or version bump.
